aulani.name: Aulani, Disney Vacation Club Villas

resale_avg_price_per_point.basis: DVC Resale Market average SOLD (closed-deal) price per point, by month the contract sold

rofr_recent.source_basis: DVC Resale Market contracts only (not market-wide)
rofr_recent.threshold_note: Disney does not publish a ROFR threshold. 'Highest buyback price' is the max $/pt Disney paid that month; contracts priced below these levels carry elevated ROFR risk. Treat as an indicator, not a rule.

liquidity.notes: Per-resort days-on-market not published. DVCRM and Fidelity both state >90% of listings sell within 30 days (marketplace-wide). Use ytd_2026_contracts_sold as a relative volume/liquidity proxy (DVCRM only).

notes: Subsidized-dues Aulani contracts (developer-subsidized, from early sales) pay $8.2369/pt in 2026 vs $10.9572 standard; confirm subsidy status on any listing.
Aug 2026: Disney bought back a SUBSIDIZED Aulani contract (1,200+ pts) at $85/pt; DVCRM speculates subsidy elimination motivated it. Rolling-year Aulani ROFR high $101 (Feb 2026).
dvcmarket.com blog cites Aulani dues ~$8.04/pt for 2026 — that conflicts with DVCNews' published figures and is NOT used.
Deed expiration verified on the official 2026 point chart PDF footer.

Dues values are the 2026 per-point rates published by DVC (via DVCNews, Nov 20 2025; finalized by the boards Dec 2025). The official per-resort budgets are on the member site, not publicly fetchable.
CAGR computed from DVCNews historical table (rounded to cents) for 2016/2021 and exact 2026 values rounded to cents.
